audience: Mid-level developers learning an unfamiliar repository
principle: Map responsibilities first; generate deeper explanations when explored
v1: Capture immutable local source snapshots and search numbered excerpts
Generate architecture, feature, change, and follow-up explanations through configured Codex or Claude CLI
Validate source paths, line ranges, exact quotes, evidence kinds, and scene references
Compose flow, sequence, branch, state, memory, comparison, and code templates
Narrate with Serena and Qwen3-TTS 1.7B on the current machine
Play, seek, inspect sources, explore boxes, and ask questions
Export the same scene timeline and audio as a local MP4
Explain the project itself as the first journey
Keep explored chapters beneath their parent with a visible path back
Browse source files and generate a file-specific narrated walkthrough
Preserve playback positions in a navigation stack; block duplicate exploration until completion or Back
Choose semantic visual forms with rationale, source-specific steps, and deterministic motion
Align visual cues to locally recognized narration words, with honest timing fallback
Use a fixed full-precision Serena reference with verified Vulkan GPU offloading; retain native CPU speech as a configurable alternative
Explain software purpose, responsibilities, code structure, and design consequences through source-backed situations
Use GPT-6 Luna with xhigh reasoning for Codex explanations and version the narrative and model cache identities
Prioritize clicked responsibilities, cited implementations, and static import context
Preview the visual language in an interactive component gallery
follow_on: Language-aware symbols and call relationships through tree-sitter and language servers
Optional self-hosted Sourcebot or Zoekt search adapter using free capabilities
Semantic citation and narrative verification beyond exact source matching
Incremental source indexing for repositories beyond current scan limits
Evaluate native voice naturalness with listening feedback and expand alignment to verified forced alignment

constraints.renderer: owned SVG components and timeline; sharp plus FFmpeg for export
constraints.agent_models: existing configured CLI access, with hosted or locally configured providers
